decision: Close full-target response collection under this original Hangzhou demand. Retain a separate paired response measurement on the seven jointly supported count points.
question: On the two measured Hangzhou PP seeds, can the paired phase requests reproduce the observed Jinan direction of movement-level response within common supply conditions?
scope: One distinct preaction visit for every common target count point per source seed; 14 cases. Selection uses the two near counts and projected signal contrast only. These are development seeds and cases.
execution: Use the admitted package and SUMO 1.22.0. Replay the same PP prefix to each exact listed checkpoint for both arms. Verify the registered pair, counts, ordered candidates, 4/0 planned exposure and identical right trace across arms. Compare the two starts for vehicles, pending traffic and all signal executor states. Keep the other signals' PP requests identical.
outcomes: For both arms retain actual per-second right/straight signals and 10-second stop-line entry counts by movement. Report realized exposure and high-minus-low count deltas for every scheduled case. Retain valid clearance extensions even when they eliminate the contrast. Show each point and both seeds, with point means within each seed. Report the same common-support subset of the prior Jinan pairs separately.
gate: Stop on crash, collision, teleport, non-reproducible checkpoint or incomplete measurement. Do not substitute cases. If the realized 4/0 contrast with identical right trace yields more straight and fewer right entries in at least one case on each seed, report a repeated local response along with all neutral and reverse cases. Otherwise close this local replication. Either outcome requires a separate decision before training or policy trials.
